blurb: Celebrate the legendary career of Kenny Rogers and Friends at GTS Theatre with an evening filled with beloved songs and heartfelt storytelling. This tribute brings to life timeless hits like “The Gambler,” “Lucille,” and “Islands in the Stream,” honoring Kenny's remarkable legacy as well as his iconic collaborations. Set in an intimate theatre, every seat offers a close connection to the performance, inviting you to laugh, sing along, and reminisce. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to his music, this show promises a memorable night that captures the spirit of country music's greatest storyteller.
